name: Spectrum SBS240CPHT 40V Cordless Pole Hedge Trimmer Kit, 2.4m Reach, 46cm Blade, 4.0Ah Battery + Charger
Body Copy:
Reach the top of a 2.4 metre hedge without leaving the ground. The Spectrum SBS240CPHT pole trimmer pivots its 180-degree adjustable head to cut horizontally along the top of tall hedges or vertically down the face, so awkward angles stop dictating where the work gets done. The 46cm dual-action laser-cut blade runs at 2,600 strokes per minute and slices branches up to 18mm thick, leaving clean cuts that promote healthy regrowth. At 3.62kg the tool stays balanced on the shaft, sparing wrists and shoulders on longer sessions.

This kit ships with the SBS40CB 40V 4.0Ah lithium-ion battery and the SBSCBC standard charger, ready to use on arrival. The same 40V pack drops into every other tool in the Spectrum cordless lineup, so adding a mower or leaf blower later means a bare tool, not a new platform. Backed by a 5-year domestic warranty (parts and labour years 1-2, parts only years 3-5).
Unique Selling Point 01: 2.4m total reach - trim tall hedges safely from the ground
Unique Selling Point 02: 180-degree adjustable head for horizontal and vertical trimming
Unique Selling Point 03: 46cm dual-action laser-cut blade for clean, precise cuts
Unique Selling Point 04: 2,600 strokes/min for fast, efficient trimming in fewer passes
Unique Selling Point 06: Lightweight at 3.62kg, well-balanced for extended use
Unique Selling Point 07: Compatible with every battery and charger in the Spectrum 40V cordless lineup
Selling Copy: Spectrum's 40V SBS240CPHT pole hedge trimmer extends to 2.4 metres so the top of tall hedges and high-sided borders come into easy reach from the ground. The 46cm dual-action blade cuts at 2,600 strokes per minute, and the 180-degree pivoting head handles horizontal or vertical work without repositioning. Supplied as a complete kit with a 40V 4.0Ah battery and standard charger.
